items.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports AWS Lambda Web Functions as an origin
items.blurb: Starting today, you can deliver web applications built on AWS Lambda Web Functions through CloudFront's global edge network.

items.title: Amazon EC2 G7 instances now available in Europe (Frankfurt) and Europe (Stockholm) Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) G7 instances powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs are now available in Europe (Frankfurt) and Europe (Stockholm) Regions.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now prefills step-by-step guides for after contact work
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer can now fill in the step-by-step guides that agents complete after a contact, using information extracted from customer conversations, such as booking identifiers, claim numbers, and conversation summaries.

items.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server.

items.title: Amazon S3 Express One Zone is now available in 4 additional AWS Regions
items.blurb: The Amazon S3 Express One Zone storage class is now available in 4 additional AWS Regions: Europe (London), Asia Pacific (Jakarta), Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), and Africa (Cape Town).
